##### Project general facts

Aqua Dimore redefines the very essence of contemporary living, inspiring a unique journey of experiential living in the thriving landscape. Designed with a philosophy that links royal indulgence with nature's poetic state of flow, this extraordinary development offers an immersive and perpetual vacation experience every day of your life. Introducing a never-before Sky Villa concept, each residence features expansive balconies and private plunge pools, creating a perfect oasis above the city and a testament to life's finest pleasures.

Residents enjoy an expansive leisure zone meticulously designed to nourish both body and soul. The development features landscaped green spaces, a lazy river, and cascading water fountains, inviting residents to immerse themselves in the soothing embrace of nature. Every element is crafted to create a serene setting where relaxation and rejuvenation come naturally.

Every residence at Aqua Dimore is inspired by the aesthetics of the Victorian era, combining classical architectural motifs with modern comfort. Interiors feature designer walls and false ceilings, custom-made designer chandeliers, designer mood lighting, marble countertops, European branded fixtures and fittings, and gold-finished accessories. Kitchens are fully fitted, creating elegant living spaces with a distinctive character and refined sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Science Park, a thriving innovation community and dynamic hub where professionals, scientists, researchers, and entrepreneurs come together to exchange knowledge and inspire each other, this exceptional location offers a unique ecosystem at the heart of progress. With a commitment to sustainability, collaboration, and the pursuit of knowledge, the area is a beacon for those who seek to make a difference.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity to key destinations across the city. Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Autodrome, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club, and IMG Worlds of Adventure are all within easy reach, while Dubai Marina, Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, and both international airports are just minutes away.

For those seeking a residence that embodies experiential luxury, aquatic serenity, and strategic connectivity, Dubai Science Park delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of innovation, nature, and a prime location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — refined, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
